name: Yume no Ato
source:
These two stories - Mone and Neneko - show how two people can understand each other so good that problems become shared and easily solved.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“Mone”与“宁宁子”这两篇故事，展现了两个人如何通过深刻的相互理解，共同分担烦恼，让难题迎刃而解。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
